name: Tavern Brawler
flavor: Ira furor brevis est: anger is a brief madness. (Horace, Epistles 1.2)

name: Vine-Crowned Bacchant
text: Haste (This creature can attack and use Tap abilities the turn it enters.)
flavor: Nunc est bibendum: now is the time for drinking, now the time to beat the earth with unfettered foot. (Horace, Odes 1.37)

name: Masquerade Duelist
text: First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
flavor: Behind the gilded mask, a smile; behind the smile, a blade.

name: Courtier on the Chaise
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Courtier on the Chaise is untapped and didn't attack this turn, it deals 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: Men ought either to be well treated or crushed. (Machiavelli, The Prince)

name: Loafer of the Arbour
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Loafer of the Arbour is untapped and didn't attack this turn, rummage. (Draw a card, then discard a card.)
flavor: A Book of Verses underneath the Bough, a Jug of Wine, a Loaf of Bread, and Thou. (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Sleepy Baronet
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Sleepy Baronet is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
flavor: When you want a laugh, come and see me, fat and sleek and well cared for, a hog from Epicurus' herd. (Horace, Epistles 1.4)

name: Fire-Eater of the Feast
text: When Fire-Eater of the Feast enters, it deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: The guests applaud. The guest nearest the stage stops applauding.

name: Gluttonous Baron
text: When Gluttonous Baron enters, you lose 2 life.
flavor: Nothing is enough for the man to whom enough is too little. (Epicurus, Vatican Sayings)

name: Masked Reveller
text: Carouse: As long as you've played another non-land card this turn, Masked Reveller has haste.
flavor: Behind a mask, every man is braver and none of them is sober.

name: Carousing Lancer
text: Haste (This creature can attack and use Tap abilities the turn it enters.)
flavor: He charged the enemy line still holding his goblet, and never spilled a drop.

name: Satyr of the Drowsy Vineyard
text: Haste (This creature can attack and use Tap abilities the turn it enters.) Idle: At the end of your turn, if Satyr of the Drowsy Vineyard is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
flavor: He meant to join the raid. Then the afternoon grew warm.

name: Garlanded Festival Bull
text: When Garlanded Festival Bull enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Gild his horns, hang him with roses, and point him at the enemy. The procession will sort itself out. (a steward of the Feast)

name: Toast of Fire
text: Toast of Fire deals 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Come, fill the Cup, and in the fire of Spring / Your Winter-garment of Repentance fling. (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Firecracker Garland
text: Firecracker Garland deals 1 damage to target enemy creature. Carouse: If you've played another non-land card this turn, it also deals 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: Strung across the square for the feast day, lit one at a time, aimed carelessly.

name: Spilled Brandy
text: Spilled Brandy deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Then rummage. (Draw a card, then discard a card.)
flavor: One clumsy elbow, one candle, and the evening became memorable.

name: Rowdy Chorus
text: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. Carouse: If you've played another non-land card this turn, they get an additional +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Nobody remembers the second verse, so they sing the first one louder.

name: Flaming Flagon
text: Flaming Flagon deals 3 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: It was poured for him. It simply arrived faster than he expected.

name: Banquet Flambe
text: Banquet Flambe deals 4 damage to target enemy creature.
flavor: The chef insists it is meant to burn that brightly.

name: Carnival Brazier

abilities.text: Tap, Pay 1 life: Carnival Brazier deals 1 damage to the enemy player.

text: Tap, Pay 1 life: Carnival Brazier deals 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: The things which produce certain pleasures entail annoyances many times greater than the pleasures themselves. (Epicurus, Principal Doctrines)

name: Festival Drum

abilities.text: {R}, Tap: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

text: {R}, Tap: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: When the drum begins, even the sleepiest baron finds his feet.

name: Wandering Minstrel
text: Haste (This creature can attack and use Tap abilities the turn it enters.)
flavor: Carpe diem: seize the day, trusting as little as possible in tomorrow. (Horace, Odes 1.11)

name: Tumbler of the Fair
text: Tumbler of the Fair gets +1/+0 for each other Performer you control.
flavor: He lands every somersault, and every somersault lands on someone.

name: Mummer of the Twelfth Night
text: First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
flavor: Every Twelfth Night he slays the paper dragon with a wooden sword. The dragon has never once won.

name: Perfumed Lordling
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Perfumed Lordling is untapped and didn't attack this turn and you control another Noble, it deals 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: Odi profanum vulgus et arceo: I hate the uninitiated crowd and keep it far from me. (Horace, Odes 3.1)

name: Count of the Velvet Glove
text: First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.) Idle: At the end of your turn, if Count of the Velvet Glove is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
flavor: A wise lord cannot, nor ought he to, keep faith when such observance may be turned against him. (Machiavelli, The Prince)

name: Shouts of Encore
text: Performers you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: The crowd roared for more, and the players gave it to the front rank of the enemy.

name: Toast to the Peerage
text: Toast to the Peerage deals 1 damage to the enemy player for each Noble you control.
flavor: It is much safer to be feared than loved, when, of the two, either must be dispensed with. (Machiavelli, The Prince)

name: Satyr Piper of the Pines
text: When Satyr Piper of the Pines enters, Satyrs you control gain haste until end of turn.
flavor: His tune has no words, but every goat-footed rascal on the hill knows it means "charge".

name: Wineskin Satyr
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Wineskin Satyr is untapped and didn't attack this turn, rummage. (Draw a card, then discard a card.)
flavor: Now drive away your cares with wine; tomorrow we sail the vast sea again. (Horace, Odes 1.7)

name: Shovel of Embers
text: Shovel of Embers deals 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: The innkeeper keeps no sword behind the bar. The fire is always lit, and the shovel is always warm.

name: Gambler's Ruin
text: Gambler's Ruin deals 3 damage to target enemy creature. You lose 2 life.
flavor: Quid sit futurum cras, fuge quaerere: cease to ask what tomorrow will bring. (Horace, Odes 1.9)

name: Pawn the Heirlooms
text: Rummage twice. (Each time, draw a card, then discard a card.)
flavor: Have drown'd my Glory in a shallow Cup, / And sold my Reputation for a Song. (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Cinder-Hoof Satyr
text: Unearth {R} ({R}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)
flavor: Every dawn he is ash. Every dusk he is dancing again, and a little less of him each time.

name: Duelist of the Velvet Court
text: First strike. Whenever Duelist of the Velvet Court attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
flavor: He has never lost a duel, nor an argument about wine.

name: Masked Firebreather
text: Whenever Masked Firebreather attacks, it deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Every performance ends with a bow and a scorched front row.

name: Jester of the Lazy Court
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Jester of the Lazy Court is untapped and didn't attack this turn, it deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Mix a little folly with your plans: it is sweet to play the fool in season. (Horace, Odes 4.12)

name: Host of the Lantern Garden
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Host of the Lantern Garden is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
flavor: We call pleasure the beginning and end of the blessed life. (Epicurus, Letter to Menoeceus)

name: Fencing Master of the Masque
text: First strike. Carouse: As long as you've played another non-land card this turn, Fencing Master of the Masque has haste.
flavor: He teaches only at night, and only to students who arrive already drunk.

name: Hierophant of the Bacchanal
text: Haste. When Hierophant of the Bacchanal enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: "Tonight there is no tomorrow. Drink, and charge!"

name: Margrave of the Long Table
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Margrave of the Long Table is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put two +1/+1 counters on it and you lose 2 life.
flavor: It is not an unbroken succession of drinking-bouts and of revelry... which produce a pleasant life. (Epicurus, Letter to Menoeceus)

name: Second Bottle
text: Second Bottle deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Carouse: If you've played another non-land card this turn, it also deals 2 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: The first bottle is for the guests. The second is for the host's enemies.

name: Satisfaction at Dawn
text: Satisfaction at Dawn deals 3 damage to target enemy creature. Carouse: If you've played another non-land card this turn, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Insulted at supper, challenged at midnight, buried by breakfast.

name: Pyre-Dancer's Whirl
text: Pyre-Dancer's Whirl deals 2 damage to each enemy creature. You lose 2 life.
flavor: Death is nothing to us. (Epicurus, Principal Doctrines)

name: Empty the Cellar
text: Rummage twice. (Each time, draw a card, then discard a card.) Then Empty the Cellar deals 2 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: Drink! for you know not whence you came, nor why: / Drink! for you know not why you go, nor where. (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Bottomless Wine Cask
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, rummage. (Draw a card, then discard a card.)
flavor: The Wine of Life keeps oozing drop by drop, / The Leaves of Life keep falling one by one. (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Carnival Masks
text: Carouse: As long as you've played another non-land card this turn, creatures you control have first strike.
flavor: Every one sees what you appear to be, few really know what you are. (Machiavelli, The Prince)

name: Master of the Revels
text: Your Performer creature cards cost {1} less to play. This effect reduces only generic mana.
flavor: He hires the jugglers, pays the fire-eaters, and sends the bill for both to the Crown.

name: Master of the Pageant Wagon
text: Other Performers you control get +1/+0 and have haste. (They can attack and use Tap abilities the turn they enter.)
flavor: When his wagon rolls into town, the whole company leaps down already performing.

name: Gossiping Marquis
text: Gossiping Marquis gets +1/+1 for each other Noble you control.
flavor: Men judge generally more by the eye than by the hand. (Machiavelli, The Prince)

name: Lord of Misrule
text: Whenever another Performer enters under your control, Lord of Misrule deals 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: In all their rule there was but this one clause to be observed: Do what thou wilt. (Rabelais, Gargantua)

name: Royal Command Performance
text: Royal Command Performance deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player for each Performer you control.
flavor: The king asked for something with fire in it. The players were happy to oblige.

name: Old Satyr on the Wine-Cask
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Old Satyr on the Wine-Cask is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target Satyr you control.
flavor: Eheu fugaces, Postume, Postume: alas, Postumus, Postumus, the fleeting years slip by. (Horace, Odes 2.14)

name: Panic in the Thicket
text: Panic in the Thicket deals 1 damage to target enemy creature for each Satyr you control.
flavor: Out of the dark wood came a skirl of pipes and a clatter of hooves, and the sentries forgot their courage.

name: Torchbearer of the Rout
text: When Torchbearer of the Rout enters, it deals 1 damage to target enemy creature for each Satyr you control.
flavor: He knows the way into the wood by heart. No one has ever asked him the way out.

name: Salamander Juggler
text: Haste. Whenever Salamander Juggler attacks, it deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Three living flames in the air, and not one of them is happy about it.

name: Prince of Idle Hours
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Prince of Idle Hours is untapped and didn't attack this turn, it deals 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: He has not lifted a finger in years. He has never needed to.

name: Master of the Midnight Duel
text: First strike, haste. Carouse: As long as you've played another non-land card this turn, Master of the Midnight Duel gets +2/+0.
flavor: He fights only after the last dance, when the candles gutter and the witnesses are asleep.

name: Archduke of the Endless Feast
text: Haste. At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life.
flavor: Ah, make the most of what we yet may spend, / Before we too into the Dust descend. (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Giant of the Groaning Board
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Giant of the Groaning Board is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then rummage. (Draw a card, then discard a card.)
flavor: He sat down to dinner a year ago. The table has since been rebuilt around him twice.

name: Grand Conflagration
text: Grand Conflagration deals 5 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Pulvis et umbra sumus: we are dust and shadow. (Horace, Odes 4.7)

name: Night Without End
text: Creatures you control get +3/+0 until end of turn. You lose 3 life.
flavor: Suns may set and rise again; for us, when once our brief light has set, there is one endless night to be slept. (Catullus, Carmina 5)

name: Carnival of Cinders
text: Carnival of Cinders deals 3 damage to each creature and 3 damage to the enemy player. You lose 1 life.
flavor: The carnival ended as all carnivals end: in ashes, and someone else's house.

name: Lanterns of the Pleasure Garden
text: Creatures you control have haste.
flavor: Unborn To-morrow, and dead Yesterday, / Why fret about them if To-day be sweet! (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: King of the Minstrels
text: Haste (This creature can attack and use Tap abilities the turn it enters.) Other Performers you control get +1/+1.
flavor: Rex ministrallorum, the rolls call him, and every fiddler in the shire owes him a penny a year.

name: Elector of the Endless Banquet
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Elector of the Endless Banquet is untapped and didn't attack this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each Noble you control.
flavor: Men are ungrateful, fickle, false, cowardly, covetous. (Machiavelli, The Prince)

name: Horned Lord of the Rout
text: Other Satyrs you control have haste. (They can attack and use Tap abilities the turn they enter.) Idle: At the end of your turn, if Horned Lord of the Rout is untapped and didn't attack this turn, it deals 1 damage to the enemy player for each Satyr you control.
flavor: He sends the herd down the hill at a gallop and follows at his own pace, which is to say not at all.

name: Vessar, Master of the Undying Feast
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Vessar is untapped and didn't attack this turn, it deals 1 damage to each enemy creature and 2 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: Dust into Dust, and under Dust to lie, / Sans Wine, sans Song, sans Singer, and sans End! (Omar Khayyam, tr. FitzGerald)

name: Brandimarte, Prince of Fire-Eaters
text: Haste, first strike. Whenever Brandimarte attacks, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: He drinks fire, duels for sport, and has never once been on time for his own wedding.

name: The Undying Bonfire

abilities.text: Pay 2 life: The Undying Bonfire deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Activate only once each turn.

text: At the beginning of your upkeep, The Undying Bonfire deals 1 damage to each creature and 1 damage to the enemy player, and you lose 1 life. Pay 2 life: The Undying Bonfire deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Activate only once each turn.
flavor: It was lit for one feast day. Nobody remembers which, and nobody can put it out.

name: Ruggiero, Patron of the Players
text: Performers you control have first strike. (They deal combat damage before creatures without first strike.) Idle: At the end of your turn, if Ruggiero is untapped and didn't attack this turn, it deals 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player for each Performer you control.
flavor: He has never drawn a sword. He keeps forty players who throw fire on cue.
